question_text: Was the GitHub outage on Nov 25 a cyberattack?
answer_text: Not established. GitHub blames high database load and fixed it within the hour. It has not said what drove the load up or mentioned an attack, no one has claimed one, and a root cause analysis is promised.
label: Not established
what_would_settle_it: GitHub's root cause analysis, or its monthly availability report for November, saying what drove the database load; or a statement from a security authority or an outside investigator.

answer_text: GitHub's own account is that high database load caused the failures and that changing how the load was spread brought recovery. It has not yet said why the load rose.
label: Confirmed

answer_text: Yes. GitHub marked the outage resolved at 11:52 AM ET on Nov 25, under an hour after it began, and its status page showed all systems operational at our evening check. A separate Git LFS slowdown that evening was fixed by 7:28 PM ET.
label: Confirmed

question_text: Was the Git LFS slowdown later on Nov 25 an attack?
answer_text: Not established. GitHub says a large volume of automated, unauthenticated traffic overwhelmed its Git LFS servers in one region. It does not call that an attack or say where the traffic came from.
label: Not established
what_would_settle_it: GitHub saying who or what sent the traffic.

question_text: Is GitHub's push into AI causing its outages?
answer_text: Not established. Commenters raise it, but GitHub's account of Nov 25 names high database load, and nothing it has published links this outage to AI tools or AI-written code. Nothing public rules it out either.
label: Not established
what_would_settle_it: GitHub's root cause analysis saying what drove the database load.

question_text: Has GitHub had other outages this month?
answer_text: Yes. GitHub's status page lists several other November incidents, including unexpected sign-outs from Nov 5 to Nov 19 that it said were a bug and not a security incident. Its October report counted eight incidents.
label: Confirmed

what_would_settle_it: GitHub giving a share of failed requests or a number of affected users.
